name: Oleander
source:
"You want my attention? You've got it, minx. Meet me later and you'll see what that gets you."

A market needs things to sell, and Oleander is happy to provide anything you can ask for, at a price. Hedonic and charming, he makes all his work into games, but he won't say to what end he's playing.

[From [url=https://rottenraccoons.itch.io/obscura]itch.io[/url]]
